documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for BOARD MEETING TO BE HELD ON 04.11.2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, with revenue reaching Rs. 849,933 lakhs and PAT improving to Rs. 35,165 lakhs, driven by organic growth and strong contributions from Chennai retail outlets. Management remains committed to an asset-light expansion model, a disciplined funding philosophy divided equally among equity, customer advances, and external borrowings, and expanding to 100 retail outlets in Tamil Nadu by 2030. Despite external headwinds such as heightened gold and silver price volatility and regulatory import duty increases, the company maintained robust liquidity, high inventory hedging coverage, and a steady customer base.
